provenance_policy: Strict separation of OBSERVED, DERIVED, MODELLED, CASE_BRIEF_BASELINE, STATUTORY_TAX, and MISSING_DATA_ILLUSTRATIVE.
validation_policy: Strict 3-way split: expanding-window validation inside train_pool only; final holdout untouched until after model selection.
uncertainty_policy: Parametric ARIMA 95% PIs export exclusively to Model_PI_95_Lower/Upper (PARAMETRIC_MODEL_BASED); heuristic/empirical ranges export exclusively to Approx_Range_Lower/Upper (APPROXIMATE_UNCALIBRATED_RANGE).

nextjs_api_contract.forecasts: /api/forecasts/[material] -> outputs/forecasts/[material]_forecast.csv (fields: Predicted_Value, Model_PI_95_Lower, Model_PI_95_Upper, Approx_Range_Lower, Approx_Range_Upper, Interval_Methodology, Interval_Calibration_Status)
